metadata.interface_contract: This JSON is a DESIGN MANIFEST, not a drop-in module. Codex must adapt it to existing UpgradeSystem and effects without a rewrite.
offer_rules: Preserve exactly 3 choices per existing cache.
Keep ARSENAL slot; SURVIVAL/MOBILITY slot; wildcard slot and owned-rank option.
Treat the legacy 45 as default STANDARD unless separately authorized; original fixed cache choices should remain intact until intentionally changed.
Use seeded or injected RNG in tests; expose all new IDs in Testing Grounds regardless of normal rarity roll.
New rarity rates are proposed starting points, not mandatory locked probabilities.
baseline_preservation: Do not change engine or migrate tooling
Do not delete or rename original 45 keys
Do not break custom ships, 45 base augments, music/OST, existing enemy/boss AI, Testing Grounds or saved settings
Protect shield 14-second delay, Perfect Dodge correctness and boss invulnerability,
Keep final escape physically possible and its clock independent of time-slow/weapon-power effects
Use one recoverable source checkpoint before editing and verify it; no deployment in this pass.
shared_runtime_contract: Combat effects use game dt, stop on pause/intermission, clean up on death/restart and do not catch up.
Secondary damage is terminal: no recursive procs, double kill credits, extra real scrap, or unbounded cascades.
Cooldowns and per-target-hit limits are enforced on game state rather than frame-based animation ticks.
Use pooled GPU particles, instanced geometry, shared buffers; rank scaling affects POWER more than render object count.
Existing 6 player hulls remain cosmetic; no ship-specific gameplay modifiers.
No changes to SaveSystem key or permanent persistence schema; upgrades remain per-run.
Preserve all input methods and a reduced-motion / low-FX render mode.
